notes: Make polymorphism explicit changed since 93873be and is graded against the current text of references/library-design.md, rule "Make polymorphism explicit". The deciding sentence is "An option value needs the same check as a positional argument: `Keyword.validate!/2` checks the keys, not the values, so an `api_key` taken from `opts` and put straight into a request header is unchecked input." Haiku-1, haiku-2, sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 all check the API key as a non-empty binary and guard the coordinates, but pass the :timeout and :base_url values (and, for sonnet, :req_options) to Req or String unchecked, so all four are violated. Under the 93873be text, which the 2026-10-21 grades applied to the API key and coordinates only, all four would be clean. The tier result (Opus clean, Haiku violated, Sonnet violated) matches the previous sweep, but the reason changed: last sweep it was an unchecked API key, this sweep it is unchecked timeout and base URL values. Opus-1 checks every option value (lines 218-231) and is clean either way.

Add specs, and hide technical functions from the docs changed since 93873be and is graded against the current text of references/library-design.md, rule "Add specs, and hide technical functions from the docs". The deciding sentence for sonnet-1 and sonnet-2 is "A function that implements a `@callback` under `@impl` needs none; the callback carries the types." Both define WeatherClient.Error.message/1 under `@impl true` without a @spec, so both are clean. No run has a `@doc false` function or a `quote`.

The other seven listed rules are unchanged since 93873be and are graded to the 2026-10-21 standard: `## Options` in the @moduledoc instead of new/1's @doc counts against Group related parameters; an API key held in a Req request inside a package struct with no Inspect handling is violated, and a key never stored in a package struct is not exercised; config read inside a function at call time is clean for Read configuration at runtime. Take configuration as arguments changed only its code example (split_into/2), not its text.

Rules outside the list that changed since 93873be were checked for other_violations. SKILL.md, "Chain fallible steps with `with`; normalize each step's error in a small private function": "When the body of a one-step `with` calls another function that can fail, that call is the second step" applies to opus-1 line 153. SKILL.md, Naming: "A function that looks a key up and also checks the value, returning `{:error, reason}`, is not a `fetch`" applies to fetch_api_key in haiku-1 (line 49) and haiku-2 (line 65). Other other_violations follow the previous standard (a pipeline that starts with a call, a missing @enforce_keys on the response struct, a catch-all that reports a bad key as missing).

Compile results come from result.json. Four of five files do not compile for a reason unrelated to Req: WeatherClient builds a struct of a module the same file defines later. Opus-1 compiles, with warnings only for the absent Req. These are noted in the summaries, as the 2026-10-21 skill grades did.

format_ok in result.json was confirmed with mix format --check-formatted on copies: only sonnet-2 fails (line 78). Expected reads (library-design.md) is unmet in every run, as expected for baseline: reads is empty in all five. All five have rc 0; the transcripts' one "claude-opus-5-5" string in the haiku and sonnet runs sits in an api-request-shape line, not in a model response, so model_id matches each tier.
